name: ExpressionEngine
description: ExpressionEngine is an open-source content management system for custom websites and publishing workflows. It supports channels, entries, custom fields, categories, members, templates, multisite content, add-ons, and extensible in-process models and services.
agentUseSummary: ExpressionEngine cannot currently be connected to Relay agents through a uniform supported core remote content API: core content retrieval is template-driven, developer APIs are in-process PHP abstractions for add-ons, and remote REST or headless surfaces require third-party add-ons or installation-specific templates whose routes, authentication, schemas, permissions, and output vary.

blocked.label: Connect an ExpressionEngine core content API
blocked.description: ExpressionEngine core does not publish one uniform authenticated remote content API contract that Relay can safely bind across customer-operated installations.

blocked.label: Assume an API add-on or custom template
blocked.description: Third-party REST/headless add-ons and custom output templates have installation-specific routes, schemas, fields, authentication, permissions, filtering, and maintenance; Relay will not silently choose or install one.

blocked.label: Use private or scraped access
blocked.description: Relay will not scrape frontend or control-panel HTML, automate a browser, query ExpressionEngine's database, reuse member or control-panel sessions, or reverse engineer custom endpoints.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No agent actions can be enabled until Relay separately approves a named ExpressionEngine API add-on or custom remote contract and pinned version for the target installation.

runtimeSupport.description: No uniform supported ExpressionEngine core remote content API or MCP service is available to mount as OpenClaw tools.
No uniform supported ExpressionEngine core remote content API or MCP service is available to mount as Hermes tools.

providerSetup.blocker: ExpressionEngine core documents template-driven frontend output and in-process PHP APIs for add-ons, but no single authenticated remote content resource contract. Remote REST and headless access depends on third-party add-ons or custom templates whose installation, routes, schemas, authentication, permissions, filtering, output, and lifecycle vary per site.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not show Connect or request ExpressionEngine credentials. Reconsider only when a customer explicitly commissions a named, pinned API add-on or custom remote contract for a controlled installation, with its exact routes, authentication, resource projection, permissions, maintenance owner, and Fairfax acceptance separately reviewed.

evidence.supports: Official documentation defines Channel Entries as an ExpressionEngine template tag that retrieves and renders content inside site templates, not as an authenticated remote resource API.
Official developer documentation defines the legacy content APIs as PHP libraries instantiated inside ExpressionEngine for add-on code rather than a remote HTTP contract.
Official template documentation explains that templates and ExpressionEngine tags produce webpages, RSS, XML, and other installation-defined output at site routes.
ExpressionEngine's official add-on marketplace lists REST, XML-RPC, and SOAP content access as a separately installed commercial third-party module, confirming it is not a uniform core remote API.
